request.style: English, Celtic folk ballad, clear gentle female vocal, tin whistle, fiddle, Celtic harp, bodhran, acoustic guitar, flowing and heartfelt, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On the road from Moab the dust was cold and grey
Naomi turned to her daughters and she told them go away
Go back home to your mothers, find a husband and a bed
But Ruth held on to her and this is what she said

[Chorus]
Where you go I will go
And where you stay I will stay
Your people will be my people
And your God my God
Where you die I will die
And there I will be buried
Nothing but death will part you and me

[Verse]
In the fields of Bethlehem she gathered fallen grain
Walking behind the reapers in the sun and in the rain
A kind man named Boaz saw the stranger at his door
Said may you find your refuge under the wings of the LORD

[Chorus]
Where you go I will go
And where you stay I will stay
Your people will be my people
And your God my God
Where you die I will die
And there I will be buried
Nothing but death will part you and me

[Bridge]
And she bore a son called Obed
Who was father to Jesse
Who was father to David
A king came from a stranger's faithful heart

[Outro]
Where you go I will go
Your God my God
